All Implemented Interfaces:

public class ListAbstractState<AbstractSpaceT extends AbstractState<AbstractSpaceT>> extends ArrayList<AbstractSpaceT> implements AbstractState<ListAbstractState<AbstractSpaceT>>
This ListAbstractState represents a list of AbstractStates with the semilattice operators lifted to the list.
